high_level_description: The image is a humorous meme that features a pink water bottle before and after it has been through the dishwasher. The top part of the image contains text that reads: "Put my daughter's Old Navy water bottle in the dishwasher. Long story short, now it's my wife's." The left side of the image shows the water bottle as it appears when new. It is a sleek, cylindrical bottle with a matte finish and a pink cap. A small loop is attached to the cap for easy carrying.
